title: No Oil Chicken Lettuce Cups

items: 450 grams chicken mince | for veg, go with crumbled tofu
1 tbsp gochugara or any chilli flakes
head of lettuce for the cups

method: Add chicken mince to the pan and cook it half way
Add in the garlic and onions then the capsicum and cook
In a bowl, combine the sauce ingredients and mix together
Add the sauce to the mince and stir for a few minutes
Top with your gochugara and any fresh herbs you have if you like
Scoop onto lettuce cups and enjoy
tips: You can use any veges you like for this
Wanna make it veg? use crumbled tofu <3
caption:
No Oil Chicken Lettuce Cups
30 minute dinners | easy meal prep | low carb | high protein

Nutrition: 
C: 25 | F: 10 | P: 36
Calories: 295 per serve (considering 3 serves)
Serves 2 or 3 portions depending on you! 

Ingredients
450 grams chicken mince | for veg, go with crumbled tofu
4-5 cloves, chopped garlic 
1 onion, chopped
200 grams button mushroom
1 green capsicum, cubed
sauce 
1 tbsp dark soy
1 tbsp water
1 tbsp vinegar 
1 tbsp green chilli sauce 
1 tbsp peanut butter
1 tbsp gochugara or any chilli flakes
1 tbsp black pepper
assembly 
head of lettuce for the cups 

method
add chicken mince to the pan and cook it half way
add in the garlic and onions then the capsicum and cook 
in a bowl, combine the sauce ingredients and mix together 
add the sauce to the mince and stir for a few minutes 
top with your gochugara and any fresh herbs you have if you like 
scoop onto lettuce cups and enjoy 
enjoy :)

pro tip: 
you can use any veges you like for this
wanna make it veg? use crumbled tofu <3
